title: Upward Technologies B.V. founded in Breda, Netherlands, launching DocSign and Reach
content_html: Upward Technologies B.V. was founded on 21 September 2026 in Breda, Netherlands. The new company focuses on building business software for small and mid-sized companies. At the time of its launch it already operated two of its own products: DocSign, an e-signature solution, and Reach, a B2B outreach platform. Both tools were developed in house and are available for use by businesses looking to replace manual processes with automated workflows. The company’s foundation marks the beginning of a new effort to provide tailored software solutions that fit the needs of Dutch SMEs and mid-market firms.
